shared_elements: low-relief carving of figures in profile
human legs/lower bodies in striding profile
animal in profile at ground level
ground line / base register beneath figures
justification: Both are shallow relief friezes with profile figures advancing along a common ground line, and both include an animal shown in profile low in the field beside human legs, which is a loose but real correspondence in scheme. However, A depicts a file of robed human tribute-bearers carrying vessels above a rosette border, while B shows a large hoofed animal (bull) with a crouching feline and only fragmentary human legs, so the actual subjects and the relationships between them differ substantially.
